LiveRamp enables you to collaborate responsibly with data in or across any cloud you or your partners choose to use, anywhere in the world.
Collaborate in or across any cloud
Work with your tools, your way
Dynamically connect data from any location, using a network that’s built for interoperability across identifiers, platforms, partners, and clouds.
Learn more about data collaboration
Connect data directly in the cloud with embedded identity
Resolve, translate, and deconflict identifiers directly where your data lives with LiveRamp’s identity capabilities built directly into your cloud environments.
Unlock insights from untapped data sources
Leverage insights from otherwise inaccessible data sources using the LiveRamp Clean Room – a secure, cloud-agnostic environment for collaborative targeting, analytics, and measurement.
